```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 10_confidence_intervals_r_squared
title: >
  Calculate r squared
questions:
  - id: r_squared_from_t
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      For a t statistic of 2.00 with 18 degrees of freedom, what is $r^2$?
    answer: 0.18
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      $r^2 = t^2 / (t^2 + df) = 4 / (4 + 18) = 0.18$.
```
